title: 😥 Minab School painting exhibition
text:
😥 Minab School painting exhibition"

"Abbas Araghchi, Iran's FM: I visited the painting exhibition centered on Minab School, featuring works by contemporary Iranian artists. It is an exhibition where art weeps—and moves you to tears."

"In the silence of each canvas flows a story of the suffering and oppression endured by the children of Minaab. Colors speak where words fall short, and the canvases cry out what can never be put into language."

"Behind these colors and images stands the bitter memory of a crime committed by the enemies of Iran against the innocent children of this land—a crime that time will neither erase nor dim from the memory of our grieving nation."

"The tragedy of Minaab is an eternal wound on Iran’s soul. It is only fitting that our artists have given voice to this wound through their art, so that what these oppressed children went through is not lost in the noise of passing time. I invite all my fellow compatriots and lovers of contemporary Iranian art to visit this exhibition.
